Psiphon 108 handler apk download for all versions of android phones with stable servers to connect easily.

 Features of Psiphon 108 Handler 
– Handler Menu Rebranded
– Latest Version
– Connects Faster Than Before
– Optimized For Lollipop Android Phones
– Stable servers maximise connection- Vpn Logs

– Graph to view server performance.

Download

 ➡ Psiphon 108 Handler.apkPsiphon 108 Handler Settings

– Install and open the handler

– In handler menu tick remove port

– Proxy Type: Real Host

– Proxy Server: redirect.glo.com or any working Proxy Server.

– Real Proxy Type: Default.

– Scroll down and save

– Next a option box will appear chose tunnel whole device.

– Click start to connect , Psiphon 108 handler will select the best server for you while connecting or you chose your preferred server.

Always come back for updates
